content.comment_body: Hello, I have uploaded my [product_name] web application to AWS and everything works fine except for the clock feature. In the [product_name] Web Editor, all parameters must be set to the IoT Thing name based on AWS, but for the clock I am unable to change the IoT Thing name. Clicking on the IoT Thing name in the clock does not work; it only shows: ddd. HH:mm:ss, yy-MM-dd, instead of an actual clock value in my AWS web app. Please help. Thank you very much.

Hi [user_name], could you please attach some screenshots of the issue you are seeing? I am having trouble understanding the problem. Have you confirmed that your [product_name] device has internet access? Additionally, I suggest reviewing sections 2.6.5.1 and 2.6.5.2 of the [document].

Hello [user_name], it seems you are encountering problems with the IoT connection for your clock feature on AWS. This might relate to how the IoT Thing is configured or its topic subscription settings. Please verify that your IoT Thing and its permissions are set up correctly, and ensure the correct topic is being subscribed to. If the settings are correct, there may be an issue in the clock code that prevents communication with the IoT Thing. Review the code to ensure the necessary functions are called to establish the connection and fetch updates. If issues persist, consider reaching out to AWS support for troubleshooting help.

Sorry for the late response. I've attached a screenshot. The clock function only works on the local web server, but after deploying the web app to AWS, the clock does not work while other parameters do, since their IoT Thing names can be changed except in the clock feature. I think the problem is that the clock cannot change its IoT Thing name in the Web Editor (the option is disabled), so the web app doesn't receive data from the IoT Thing. Please let me know if I'm mistaken and help me resolve this issue.
Were you able to find a solution for this problem? I am experiencing the same issue.
Which version of the Web Editor are you using? I currently have version [version_no]. I am able to select different clock displays.
Hi, I also use version [version_no]. Which clock format works for you? All formats I've tried only display the template on the website, not the actual time.
Hi, has this issue been resolved? I am facing the same problem: after deploying to AWS, the clock does not show the time, only the format ddd. HH:mm:ss yyy-MM-dd. See attached photo.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have reported that the clock feature in their [product_name] Web Editor application does not show the actual time once deployed to AWS; instead, only the date-time format template is displayed. Other application parameters function correctly, and the inability to change the IoT Thing name for the clock is believed to cause the issue. Users across different [product_name] Web Editor versions are experiencing this problem, suggesting it is a wider limitation or bug rather than isolated misconfiguration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the clock feature to display live, accurate time on the AWS-deployed web app, matching its performance on a local web server, with the ability to connect the clock to the necessary IoT Thing in the configuration.
pain_keywords: template format shown instead of data
